mapper.select: SELECT ENDPOINT, P256DH, AUTH, EMPNO FROM PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS ps USING DUAL ON (ps.ENDPOINT = #{endpoint}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ps.P256DH = #{p256dh}, ps.AUTH = #{auth}, ps.EMPNO = #{empno} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ENDPOINT, P256DH, AUTH, EMPNO) VALUES (#{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{empno})
mapper.select: SELECT ENDPOINT, P256DH, AUTH, EMPNO FROM PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE EMPNO IS NOT NULL AND EMPNO NOT IN (SELECT EMPNO FROM EMP_KAKAO)
